test_cases.name: Standard Eligible Registration for CS301
test_cases.description: Student meets all prerequisites (CS101, CS201), CGPA 8.5 >= 7.0, Year 2 >= 2, and credit load within 24.

test_cases.name: Missing Prerequisite CS201 for CS301
test_cases.description: Student completed CS101 but has not completed CS201 and has no waiver.

test_cases.name: Valid Course-Specific Faculty Prerequisite Waiver
test_cases.description: Student lacks CS201 but has an explicit faculty waiver specifically for CS301/CS201.

test_cases.name: Waiver Leakage Prevention Across Courses
test_cases.description: Student has a faculty waiver for CS201/CS101, but is applying for CS301 where CS101 and CS201 are both required.
test_cases.notes: Verifies Rule R021: waiver applies strictly to the specified course.

test_cases.name: CGPA Threshold Deficiency
test_cases.description: Student completed all prerequisites and is Year 2, but CGPA is 6.4 which is below the 7.0 threshold for CS301.

test_cases.name: Academic Year Standing Deficiency
test_cases.description: First-year student with high CGPA and prerequisites completed attempting to take Year 2 course CS301.

test_cases.name: Standard Credit Limit Exceeded Without Approval
test_cases.description: Student attempting 22 + 4 = 26 credits exceeding standard 24 limit without department approval.

test_cases.name: Valid Credit Overload Exception
test_cases.description: Final-year student with CGPA 8.9 and department approval taking 22 + 4 = 26 credits (<= 28).

test_cases.name: Absolute Credit Ceiling Exceeded
test_cases.description: Final-year student with department approval attempting 26 + 4 = 30 credits exceeding absolute cap of 28.

test_cases.name: Academic Probation Barring 400-level Registration
test_cases.description: Student on academic probation attempting to register for advanced elective CS401.

test_cases.name: Administrative Registration Hold Block
test_cases.description: Student with an active administrative hold attempting course registration.

test_cases.name: Prohibited Course Repetition
test_cases.description: Student attempting to register for CS101, which they have already completed.

test_cases.name: Missing Fact: Unknown CGPA
test_cases.description: Student meets all prerequisites but CGPA is unknown. Could be eligible (if >= 7.0) or ineligible (if < 7.0).

test_cases.name: Missing Fact: Unknown Faculty Waiver
test_cases.description: Student lacks CS301 prerequisite CS201 and faculty waiver status is unknown.
test_cases.notes: Verifies 3-way reasoning on missing approval status.

test_cases.name: Missing Fact: Unknown Academic Year
test_cases.description: Student year standing is unknown for 400-level course CS401.
